room_rent.note: Proportionate deduction applies on other expenses if higher room taken; pharmacy, consumables, implants, diagnostics excluded from proportionate deduction

icu.note: No proportionate deduction for ICU room exceeding limit

copayment.note: Mandatory 5% co-pay applies to every admissible claim for all insured persons

sub_limits.display: Cataract capped; modern treatments at 50% SI
sub_limits.note: Cataract: 25% of SI or ₹40,000 per eye per year, whichever lower; listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, etc.) capped at 50% of SI in aggregate

initial_waiting.note: Waived for accidents; not applicable if continuously covered for 12+ months

ped_waiting.note: Reducible via portability credit from prior continuous coverage

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24 months for cataract, hernia, hydrocele, piles, etc.; 36 months for joint replacement and age-related osteoarthritis/osteoporosis

maternity.note: Maternity expenses explicitly excluded (Excl18); ectopic pregnancy is covered

cumulative_bonus.note: 5% added per claim-free year; reduced at same rate if claim made; max 50% of SI

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy

day_care.note: All day-care treatments covered; time limit of 24 hrs not applicable for day-care

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation explicitly excluded under specific exclusions (7.19)

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment covered up to full sum insured in AYUSH hospitals

organ_donor.note: No mention of organ donor expenses in the policy wording

ambulance.note: Road ambulance only; fixed sub-limit of ₹2,000 per hospitalisation

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, stem cell therapy, etc.) covered up to 50% of SI in aggregate per policy year

consumables.note: Gloves, masks, and many consumables explicitly listed under non-payable items (List I); consumables excluded from proportionate deduction calculation

global_cover.note: Territorial limit restricts all treatment to India only (specific exclusion 7.20)

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no claim contestable except fraud; applies to original SI; enhanced SI has fresh 60-month period

grace_period.note: 15 days for monthly premium mode; 30 days for quarterly, half-yearly and annual modes

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only; not on renewals or portability/migration

portability.note: As per IRDAI portability guidelines; apply at least 45 days before renewal

notable_exclusions.display: Domiciliary treatment, OPD, treatment outside India, maternity, infertility, refractive error <7.5D, war/nuclear

optional_riders.note: No optional riders or add-ons described in the policy wording
